_comment: Per-artist and studio facts for the PMU pre-consultation emails (pre_visit_nurture_consultation_*.html). Every fact here was confirmed by the owner (2026-10-05) or is already published on pmu-annakara.com; review quotes are verbatim Google reviews (same source as pmu-annakara-home components/Testimonials.tsx). Artists are keyed by the first name salaryReview shows for the Square team member.
studioAddress: 1357 Seventh Ave, Ste C, San Diego, CA 92101

Anna.headline: 15+ years in permanent makeup and paramedical tattooing
Anna.bio: Anna has spent more than 15 years in permanent makeup and paramedical tattooing, the work that camouflages scars, stretch marks and vitiligo. For more than 5 years she has also been teaching PMU techniques to other artists, with many students trained so far.
Anna.quote: From start to finish, she was incredibly patient, meticulous, and made sure every detail was perfect.

Anastasiia.headline: 7+ years in permanent makeup
Anastasiia.bio: Anastasiia has more than 7 years of experience in permanent makeup. For more than 5 years she has also been teaching PMU techniques to other artists, with many students trained so far.
Anastasiia.quote: Honestly, Anastasia is incredibly professional and amazing at dealing with picky clients like me!

defaultArtist.headline: Permanent makeup and paramedical tattooing in San Diego
defaultArtist.bio: Our lead artists, Anna and Anastasiia, have 15+ and 7+ years in permanent makeup, and both have been teaching PMU techniques to other artists for more than 5 years.
defaultArtist.quote: The salon is cozy and very clean, and you immediately feel comfortable.
